It is suspicious because device profile 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720' was used by 5 different cards within ±14 days; near-identical amounts (mean $100.00, variation 0%) on one product code; the same purchaser/recipient email pair verizon.net / gmail.com on 100% of them; device profile 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720' had never been used on C07987-K2 before; Vesta identity flag id_15 = New.
